change.title: pr-80528-flat
change.description: ref(crons): Reorganize incident creation / issue occurrence logic
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Copied config with display schedule_type is built and then thrown away
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies `monitor.config` into `config` and swaps `schedule_type` for `get_schedule_type_display()` (lines 160-162). Line 168 then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, not `config`, so the monitor context on the occurrence event still has the raw integer `schedule_type`. The serializer it was based on returns the converted copy (`src/sentry/monitors/serializers.py:240-242`). This bug was already there before the PR and the move carries it over unchanged. Since the function now sits in its own new module, this is a cheap time to return `"config": config`, or to delete the unused copy if the raw value is what you want.

contracts.action: mark_failed now delegates to try_incident_threshold (moved from mark_failed_threshold)
contracts.equivalent_path: Removed mark_failed_threshold in the base mark_failed.py; the body of try_incident_threshold is a verbatim copy
contracts.before_after: Same order as before: refresh_from_db, then the threshold check, the status save, incident get_or_create, an occurrence for each check-in, and the monitor_environment_failed signal. The only name change inside is create_issue_platform_occurrence -> create_incident_occurrence.
contracts.visible_effect: No behaviour change. Issue occurrences and the failed signal are produced exactly as before.
contracts.failure_mode: Unchanged: exceptions from get_or_create or produce_occurrence_to_kafka propagate to the callers of mark_failed, as they did before.

contracts.action: Callers and tests that imported the moved symbols from mark_failed
contracts.equivalent_path: monitor_consumer, check_timeout, check_missed and the tests import only mark_failed
contracts.before_after: No module in the repository imports mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence (the monitors one), get_failure_reason or SimpleCheckIn from mark_failed, and no test patches those paths.

contracts.action: Loop that produces one occurrence per failed check-in
contracts.equivalent_path: Same loop as the removed mark_failed_threshold
contracts.before_after: The loop runs at most failure_issue_threshold times, because previous_checkins is sliced to that length (or is a single entry). There are no awaits or retries.
contracts.failure_mode: Bounded by failure_issue_threshold; this is synchronous Kafka production, with no change from before.

summary: This PR moves incident-threshold logic into `incidents.py`, occurrence creation into `incident_occurrence.py`, and the `SimpleCheckIn` TypedDict into `types.py`. The moved code matches the removed code apart from the renames (`mark_failed_threshold` → `try_incident_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` → `create_incident_occurrence`). No module or test imports the moved symbols from their old path, so nothing breaks. There is one "consider" finding, which predates this PR: `get_monitor_environment_context` builds a converted copy of the config and then returns the original.
